title: Battle Creek Waterworks
blurb: Swim, splash and slide away the summer heat at Battle Creek Waterpark located in Battle Creek Regional Park. The waterpark features a three-story twisting waterslide and a shallow water pool with zero-depth entry. Amenities include a sunbathing deck, lawn chairs, restrooms, showers, and changing areas.
extraNote: Open through August 30, then closed weekdays after August 23
season: Open through August 30, then closed weekdays after August 23
hoursText: 11 a.m.-8 p.m. Last admission at 7 p.m.
